data.long_description:
Discover this beautifully renovated Type 2M townhouse offering the perfect blend of style, comfort, and functionality. Featuring 3 spacious bedrooms plus a maid’s room, this upgraded home is thoughtfully designed with modern finishes and an open dining layout that creates a bright and welcoming living space.

Boasting a built-up area of 2,700 sq. ft. on a 2,753.84 sq. ft. plot, the property enjoys peaceful park and pool views, providing a serene environment ideal for families. The interiors have been newly upgraded to a high standard, with spacious living areas, well-appointed bedrooms, and plenty of natural light throughout.

Perfectly suited for comfortable family living, this home combines modern elegance with a prime community setting close to lifestyle amenities and green open spaces.

Property Features:
• Type 2M
• 3 Bedrooms + Maid’s Room
• 3 Bathrooms
• Newly Renovated & Upgraded
• Open Dining Layout
• Park & Pool View
• BUA: 2,700 sq. ft.
• Plot Size: 2,753.84 sq. ft.
• Bright & Spacious Interiors
• Family-Friendly Community

An excellent opportunity for those seeking a stylish upgraded home in a peaceful and well-connected neighborhood.

Company Name: Provident Real Estate
RERA ORN: 1933
